objective: Build and dogfood a safe, resumable, recursively self-improving harness for autonomous engineering.

work_items.objective: Implement the local reconciled control loop with durable state, fenced leases, isolated worktrees, verification gates, and fast-forward promotion.
acceptance: A stale lease generation cannot change current run state.
Dispatch stops if the SPEC revision or base commit changed.
Promotion stops if a gate fails or the base commit changed.

work_items.objective: Use autobuild to propose, evaluate, and promote one measurable improvement to autobuild itself.
acceptance: The candidate runs in an isolated worktree.
The candidate passes all baseline gates.
The evaluation records a measurable non-regression or improvement.
Promotion is fast-forward only and leaves durable evidence.
